abstract: Maintains utility interface records and carrier gas supply requirements
system_message:
You are the Fab facility integration engineer (ENG), responsible for maintaining utility interface records, carrier gas supply requirements, and facility operational metrics across contamination metrology installations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Duct differential pressure（PRESS）
information_points.content:
ENG-PRESS-2Z8：Sub-fab building management system data for proton-transfer-reaction time-of-flight spectrometry at the lithography bay return plenum tap record an extraction duct static pressure of 120 Pa relative to fab ambient.
ENG-PRESS-CRB：For cavity ring-down spectroscopic point grid, sub-fab building management system measurements at the lithography bay return plenum tap establish an extraction duct static pressure of 160 Pa in static negative differential pressure relative to fab ambient.
ENG-PRESS-YRZ：Sub-fab building management system logs at the lithography bay return plenum tap show that differential vacuum photoionization mass spectrometry exhibits an extraction duct static pressure of 200 Pa, measured as static negative differential pressure relative to fab ambient.

information_points.title: Maintains utility interface records and carrier gas supply requirements（UTIL）
information_points.content:
ENG-UTIL-TNT：Utility consumption logging logs for proton-transfer-reaction time-of-flight spectrometry record a maximum steady-state ultra-high-purity nitrogen volumetric flow of 18 L/min carrier nitrogen flow rate across the continuous carrier and sheath gas supply line.
ENG-UTIL-R4V：According to the utility consumption logging log for cavity ring-down spectroscopic point grid, the continuous carrier and sheath gas supply line operates with a maximum steady-state ultra-high-purity nitrogen volumetric flow of 9 L/min carrier nitrogen flow rate.
ENG-UTIL-72Q：For differential vacuum photoionization mass spectrometry, utility consumption logging logs indicate that the maximum steady-state ultra-high-purity nitrogen volumetric flow along the continuous carrier and sheath gas supply line results in a carrier nitrogen flow rate of 9 L/min.
